text:
# Pre-market brief, Mon 2026-11-09 (as of ~8:20 AM ET)

1. **NVDA −4.5% to −6% pre** after its board opened a probe into whether CEO Jensen Huang was targeted by a foreign intelligence effort; Nvidia says no reason to believe secrets were compromised and Huang intends to stay ([Reuters/Investing](https://www.investing.com/news/stock-market-news/wall-st-futures-rise-after-rough-week-but-nvidia-unsettles-investors-5011103); [Quartz](https://qz.com/dow-futures-rally-oil-drops-inflation-data-ai-earnings-110926)). Other chips held up; AMD +3.2% on Oppenheimer upgrade to outperform, PT $600 ([CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/11/09/stock-market-movers-live-updates.html)). NVDA avoid extended to 11/13.
2. **Futures up:** Dow +0.7–1.1%, S&P +0.4–0.7%, Nasdaq-100 +0.2–0.6% after last week's post-midterm slide ([AP](https://apnews.com/article/stocks-markets-ai-trump-oil-d938f8e6ff42b3706e1d36e6245ec56b); [Yahoo](https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/live/stock-market-today-monday-november-9-dow-sp-500-nasdaq-nvidia-090535419.html)).
3. **Macro:** WTI ~$88.2, Brent −3.4% to ~$94.9 on Trump saying new Iran strikes "highly unlikely"; Trump meets Qatar PM today ([Quartz](https://qz.com/dow-futures-rally-oil-drops-inflation-data-ai-earnings-110926)). 10-yr flat ~4.86%, BTC ~$74.5k near 3-mo low, gold +1% ([investingLive](https://investinglive.com/news/investinglive-european-news-wrap-markets-await-fresh-us-iran-developments-us-cpi-data/)). Dec hike odds ~77–80% ([MarketSunrise](https://marketsunrise.com/editions/2026-11-08/)).
4. **Movers:** CEG +4% on Q3 adj EPS $5.06 vs $3.89 est., FY guide raised to $12.50–12.80 ([Investing](https://www.investing.com/news/earnings/constellation-shares-up-4-in-premarket-trade-on-q3-earnings-beat-higher-outlook-5011526)); still in AI-group avoid thru 11/10. NVR +26% as homebuilders rally on Dem tariff/SALT hopes (gap >5%, skip) and SAP +3% on JPM upgrade ([Investing](https://www.investing.com/news/stock-market-news/premarket-movers-nvidia-slides-on-huang-probe-nvr-extends-rally-5011241)). LLY ~+2% on Canada Kisunla reimbursement rec ([CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/11/09/stock-market-movers-live-updates.html)).

## Week ahead ([Schwab](https://schwabnetwork.beehiiv.com/p/week-ahead-inflation-data-neocloud-and-space-earnings); [Globe and Mail](https://www.theglobeandmail.com/investing/markets/inside-the-market/article-calendar-what-investors-need-to-know-for-the-week-ahead-165/))
- Mon: wholesale inventories 10:00; Goolsbee 10:00, Barkin 12:15. AMC: OXY, TTWO, RKLB, ASTS, TTD, HIMS.
- Tue: CPI 8:30 (core est. +0.2% m/m). BMO TDG, SE, ONON; AMC CRWV.
- Wed: Veterans Day, bonds closed. AMC CTVA.
- Thu: claims 8:30. BMO NBIS; AMC AMAT, CSCO.
- Fri: PPI 8:30.

## Swing ideas
- **SAP** long, low. JPM upgrade to Overweight on enterprise-AI deployment; ~+3% pre ([Investing](https://www.investing.com/news/stock-market-news/premarket-movers-nvidia-slides-on-huang-probe-nvr-extends-rally-5011241)). Risk: upgrade-only catalyst; software selling on AI fears; CPI Tue.
- Watch only: CEG beat-and-raise; consider logging at Tue close if AI-group avoid lifts and the gap holds.
